Results.ReviewText: The slightest breeze has blown out my burners when they are on low. I assume this is because of the gap between the lid and the grill body that exists all the way around the grill. The breeze must blow the heat out through the gap. Not a fan but I can't afford another grill so...

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about 2 months ago and have used it at least 3 times a week since then. It's easy to operate, has plenty of grill space and cooks evenly no matter where food is placed. I like how the gas canister hooks onto the side holder and the gauge lets me know how much gas I have left. The shelf under the grill comes in handy for storing my grill cleaning brush and grilling pans. The grill is very easy to move around to any location on my deck. There's only one improvement I'd ask for: The sun tends to glare off the grill's stainless sides so I'd prefer the option of wooden side shelves. My first Weber had wooden side shelves but, bear in mind, I had my first Weber for more than 30 years and I'm not surprised the side shelf feature changed. I'll buy a couple of wooden cutting boards and that'll take care of the problem for me!
Results.Title: Terrific grill!

Le Weber Spirit II E-310 se hisse la plupart du temps au premier rang des recommandations et c'est ce qui m'a fait changer d'avis.  De ce que je lisais, le Weber Spirit II E-310 est moins dispendieux et de bien meilleure qualité que la compétition.  C'est donc pour ce modèle que j'ai opté.  Il n'y a pas de mots pour exprimer comment je suis heureux de mon achat!  Le Weber Spirit II E-310 est un produit de très grande qualité, qui est excessivement facile à monter ainsi qu'à utiliser.  Je le recommande fortement!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Wife bought my first gas grill as an early birthday present. I have already cooked steaks, burgers, chicken, and vegetable skewers on the new grill. It heats very evenly and cooks very fast. Although I had cooked on gas before, this grill is much better than the less expensive, flimsy grills I have often seen in the big box retailers. I didn't realize how little charcoal brings to the outdoor cooking game, because for years charcoal was the method most used by the family. The taste of charcoal and the smoke of charcoal are not missed. I am heating, cooking, and eating in a fraction of the time with everything coming off the grill perfect. I had to read up about the coating on the grill grates which I didn't realize was there until after I already had the grill. Nothing sticks and clean up is a snap.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill from Amazon. DEFINITELY worth having them put it together (which was included in the price!). As they were assembling it, we realized two of the pieces were damaged. I called Weber and they were fantastic about sending out replacement parts. After that, assembly was perfect. The grill is great, easy to learn how to use it, and does a great job. If I had it to do again, I’d buy the 4- or 5- burner model instead of the 3-burner. But that’s on me!
Results.Title: Just right!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Only a month in and I'm super happy. Bought the Spirit II 310. Food has never been better prepared and tasted better. Even heat is key. I do wish it had 4 wheels, or the 2 wheels could be installed on opposite side. I also don't like looking at the propane tank. That's why only 4 stars.
Results.Title: Great grilling experience. Hide the tank

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Despite my title, this is a great grill. The only thing I don’t like is when you try to move the grill from the left side lifting up on the drop-down shelf, the shelf comes loose. In my opinion the wheel should be on the side opposite the fixed shelf.
Results.Title: Wheels on the wrong side

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love this grill, have had 4 weber grill over the years, 2-charcoal & 2-gas.  This Weber Spirit II is outstanding, very durable, easy to light and the gauge for the bottled gas is very true to scale and the tank is easy to get to.  love the two extensions.  The outside is easy to keep clean and the whole thing is very very sturdy.  Even the drip pan is easy to get to.  LOVE THIS GRILL!!

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
